nodes.name: Schedule Trigger
nodes.notes: 07:30 ICT, Thu 2 - Thu 7 (CN nghi).

parameters.sqlQuery:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT
    DATETIME(
      DATE('{{ $('Resolve Day').first().json.report_date }}')
    ) AS day_start,

    DATETIME(
      DATE_ADD(
        DATE('{{ $('Resolve Day').first().json.report_date }}'),
        INTERVAL 1 DAY
      )
    ) AS day_end
),

course_map AS (
  -- course_key chính
  SELECT DISTINCT
    LOWER(
      TRIM(
        REGEXP_REPLACE(
          course_key,
          r'\s+',
          ' '
        )
      )
    ) AS raw_key,

    course_key,
    course_name,
    course_type

  FROM `tmdatabase.dm_daily_brief.dim_course`

  WHERE course_key IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(course_key) != ''

  UNION DISTINCT

  -- aliases
  SELECT DISTINCT
    LOWER(
      TRIM(
        REGEXP_REPLACE(
          alias,
          r'\s+',
          ' '
        )
      )
    ) AS raw_key,

    course_key,
    course_name,
    course_type

  FROM `tmdatabase.dm_daily_brief.dim_course`,
  UNNEST(
    SPLIT(
      IFNULL(aliases, ''),
      ','
    )
  ) AS alias

  WHERE course_key IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(course_key) != ''
    AND TRIM(alias) != ''
),

events AS (
  -- Lead tạo hôm qua
  SELECT
    d.deal_id,

    LOWER(
      TRIM(
        REGEXP_REPLACE(
          IFNULL(d.selected_course, ''),
          r'\s+',
          ' '
        )
      )
    ) AS raw_key,

    'lead' AS event_type

  FROM `tmdatabase.dm_base_crm.deals` d
  CROSS JOIN p

  WHERE NOT STARTS_WITH(
      IFNULL(d.failed_reason_id, ''),
      'Trash:'
    )

    AND d.created_at >= p.day_start
    AND d.created_at < p.day_end

  UNION ALL

  -- Won đóng hôm qua
  SELECT
    d.deal_id,

    LOWER(
      TRIM(
        REGEXP_REPLACE(
          IFNULL(d.selected_course, ''),
          r'\s+',
          ' '
        )
      )
    ) AS raw_key,

    'won' AS event_type

  FROM `tmdatabase.dm_base_crm.deals` d
  CROSS JOIN p

  WHERE NOT STARTS_WITH(
      IFNULL(d.failed_reason_id, ''),
      'Trash:'
    )

    AND d.deal_status = 'won'

    AND d.closed_at >= p.day_start
    AND d.closed_at < p.day_end
)

SELECT
  cm.course_type,
  cm.course_name,

  COUNT(DISTINCT IF(
    e.event_type = 'lead',
    e.deal_id,
    NULL
  )) AS leads,

  COUNT(DISTINCT IF(
    e.event_type = 'won',
    e.deal_id,
    NULL
  )) AS deals

FROM events e

INNER JOIN course_map cm
  ON cm.raw_key = e.raw_key
  AND e.raw_key != ''

GROUP BY
  cm.course_type,
  cm.course_name

ORDER BY
  cm.course_type,
  deals DESC,
  leads DESC;

nodes.name: Q2 Breakdown
nodes.notes: MVP: JOIN dim_course inline.

parameters.sqlQuery:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT
    DATETIME(
      DATE('{{ $('Resolve Day').first().json.report_date }}')
    ) AS day_start,

    DATETIME(
      DATE_ADD(
        DATE('{{ $('Resolve Day').first().json.report_date }}'),
        INTERVAL 1 DAY
      )
    ) AS day_end
),

base AS (
  SELECT
    d.deal_id,
    d.deal_status,

    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(TRIM(d.utm_source), ''),
      '(not set)'
    ) AS utm_source,

    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(TRIM(d.utm_medium), ''),
      '(not set)'
    ) AS utm_medium,

    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(TRIM(d.utm_campaign), ''),
      '(not set)'
    ) AS utm_campaign,

    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(TRIM(d.utm_content), ''),
      '(not set)'
    ) AS utm_content,

    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(TRIM(d.utm_product), ''),
      '(not set)'
    ) AS utm_product

  FROM `tmdatabase.dm_base_crm.deals` d
  CROSS JOIN p

  WHERE NOT STARTS_WITH(
      IFNULL(d.failed_reason_id, ''),
      'Trash:'
    )

    AND d.created_at >= p.day_start
    AND d.created_at < p.day_end
)

SELECT
  utm_source,
  utm_medium,
  utm_campaign,
  utm_content,
  utm_product,

  COUNT(DISTINCT deal_id)
    AS n_leads,

  COUNT(DISTINCT IF(
    deal_status = 'won',
    deal_id,
    NULL
  )) AS n_won,

  COUNT(DISTINCT IF(
    deal_status = 'lost',
    deal_id,
    NULL
  )) AS n_lost

FROM base

GROUP BY
  utm_source,
  utm_medium,
  utm_campaign,
  utm_content,
  utm_product

ORDER BY
  n_leads DESC,
  n_won DESC,
  utm_source,
  utm_medium,
  utm_campaign,
  utm_content,
  utm_product

LIMIT {{ $('Config').first().json.limits.top_utm_rows }};

nodes.notes: MVP: JOIN dim_course inline (chi de tru deal rac, khong can course cho UTM).

parameters.sqlQuery:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT
    DATE('{{ $('Resolve Day').first().json.report_date }}')
      AS report_date,

    DATETIME(
      DATE('{{ $('Resolve Day').first().json.report_date }}')
    ) AS day_start,

    DATETIME(
      DATE_ADD(
        DATE('{{ $('Resolve Day').first().json.report_date }}'),
        INTERVAL 1 DAY
      )
    ) AS day_end
),

active_courses AS (
  SELECT
    course_key,
    course_name,
    course_type,
    aliases
  FROM `tmdatabase.dm_daily_brief.dim_course`
  WHERE is_active = TRUE
    AND course_key IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(course_key) != ''
),

course_map AS (
  -- course_key chính
  SELECT DISTINCT
    LOWER(
      TRIM(
        REGEXP_REPLACE(
          course_key,
          r'\s+',
          ' '
        )
      )
    ) AS raw_key,

    course_key

  FROM active_courses

  UNION DISTINCT

  -- aliases
  SELECT DISTINCT
    LOWER(
      TRIM(
        REGEXP_REPLACE(
          alias,
          r'\s+',
          ' '
        )
      )
    ) AS raw_key,

    course_key

  FROM active_courses,
  UNNEST(
    SPLIT(
      IFNULL(aliases, ''),
      ','
    )
  ) AS alias

  WHERE TRIM(alias) != ''
),

last_lead AS (
  SELECT
    cm.course_key,

    MAX(d.created_at) AS last_lead_at

  FROM `tmdatabase.dm_base_crm.deals` d

  CROSS JOIN p

  INNER JOIN course_map cm
    ON cm.raw_key = LOWER(
      TRIM(
        REGEXP_REPLACE(
          IFNULL(d.selected_course, ''),
          r'\s+',
          ' '
        )
      )
    )

  WHERE NOT STARTS_WITH(
      IFNULL(d.failed_reason_id, ''),
      'Trash:'
    )

    -- Chỉ xét dữ liệu đến hết D-1.
    -- Không để lead hôm nay ảnh hưởng Q4.
    AND d.created_at < p.day_end

    AND NULLIF(
      TRIM(d.selected_course),
      ''
    ) IS NOT NULL

  GROUP BY
    cm.course_key
)

SELECT
  c.course_type,
  c.course_name,

  DATE(ll.last_lead_at)
    AS last_lead_date,

  DATE_DIFF(
    p.report_date,
    IFNULL(
      DATE(ll.last_lead_at),
      DATE_SUB(
        p.report_date,
        INTERVAL 999 DAY
      )
    ),
    DAY
  ) AS days_no_lead

FROM active_courses c

CROSS JOIN p

LEFT JOIN last_lead ll
  ON ll.course_key = c.course_key

WHERE
  -- Không từng có lead
  ll.last_lead_at IS NULL

  -- Hoặc lần cuối có lead là trước hôm qua
  OR ll.last_lead_at < p.day_start

ORDER BY
  days_no_lead DESC,
  c.course_type,
  c.course_name;

parameters.sqlQuery:
WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    DATE('{{ $('Resolve Day').first().json.report_date }}')
      AS report_date,

    DATETIME(
      DATE_ADD(
        DATE('{{ $('Resolve Day').first().json.report_date }}'),
        INTERVAL 1 DAY
      )
    ) AS day_end,

    {{ $('Config').first().json.thresholds.warning_pending_days }}
      AS warning_pending_days,

    {{ $('Config').first().json.thresholds.warning_open_deal_days }}
      AS warning_open_deal_days,

    {{ $('Config').first().json.thresholds.min_base_volume }}
      AS min_base_volume,

    {{ $('Config').first().json.thresholds.warning_drop_pct }}
      AS warning_drop_pct,

    {{ $('Config').first().json.thresholds.warning_zero_lead_days }}
      AS warning_zero_lead_days,

    {{ $('Config').first().json.thresholds.warning_pending_min_count }}
      AS warning_pending_min_count,

    {{ $('Config').first().json.thresholds.warning_open_deal_min }}
      AS warning_open_deal_min
),

active_courses AS (
  SELECT
    course_key,
    course_name,
    course_type,
    aliases

  FROM `tmdatabase.dm_daily_brief.dim_course`

  WHERE is_active = TRUE
    AND course_key IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(course_key) != ''
),

course_map AS (
  -- course_key chính
  SELECT DISTINCT
    LOWER(
      TRIM(
        REGEXP_REPLACE(
          course_key,
          r'\s+',
          ' '
        )
      )
    ) AS raw_key,

    course_key

  FROM active_courses

  UNION DISTINCT

  -- aliases
  SELECT DISTINCT
    LOWER(
      TRIM(
        REGEXP_REPLACE(
          alias,
          r'\s+',
          ' '
        )
      )
    ) AS raw_key,

    course_key

  FROM active_courses,
  UNNEST(
    SPLIT(
      IFNULL(aliases, ''),
      ','
    )
  ) AS alias

  WHERE TRIM(alias) != ''
),

/* =========================================================
   1. LEAD METRICS
   - current 7 days
   - previous 7 days
   - last lead date

   Việc lấy last_lead_date bắt buộc cần lịch sử,
   nên gộp lead_now / lead_prev vào cùng scan.
   ========================================================= */
lead_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    cm.course_key,

    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(
      d.created_at >= DATETIME(
        DATE_SUB(p.report_date, INTERVAL 6 DAY)
      )
      AND d.created_at < p.day_end,
      d.deal_id,
      NULL
    )) AS lead_now,

    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(
      d.created_at >= DATETIME(
        DATE_SUB(p.report_date, INTERVAL 13 DAY)
      )
      AND d.created_at < DATETIME(
        DATE_SUB(p.report_date, INTERVAL 6 DAY)
      ),
      d.deal_id,
      NULL
    )) AS lead_prev,

    MAX(d.created_at)
      AS last_lead_at

  FROM `tmdatabase.dm_base_crm.deals` d

  CROSS JOIN params p

  INNER JOIN course_map cm
    ON cm.raw_key = LOWER(
      TRIM(
        REGEXP_REPLACE(
          IFNULL(d.selected_course, ''),
          r'\s+',
          ' '
        )
      )
    )

  WHERE NOT STARTS_WITH(
      IFNULL(d.failed_reason_id, ''),
      'Trash:'
    )

    -- Không cho lead hôm nay ảnh hưởng last_lead_date
    AND d.created_at < p.day_end

  GROUP BY
    cm.course_key
),

/* =========================================================
   2. WON METRICS
   Won theo closed_at, đúng business rule.
   Chỉ cần 14 ngày nên filter ngay từ đầu.
   ========================================================= */
won_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    cm.course_key,

    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(
      d.closed_at >= DATETIME(
        DATE_SUB(p.report_date, INTERVAL 6 DAY)
      ),
      d.deal_id,
      NULL
    )) AS deal_now,

    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(
      d.closed_at < DATETIME(
        DATE_SUB(p.report_date, INTERVAL 6 DAY)
      ),
      d.deal_id,
      NULL
    )) AS deal_prev

  FROM `tmdatabase.dm_base_crm.deals` d

  CROSS JOIN params p

  INNER JOIN course_map cm
    ON cm.raw_key = LOWER(
      TRIM(
        REGEXP_REPLACE(
          IFNULL(d.selected_course, ''),
          r'\s+',
          ' '
        )
      )
    )

  WHERE NOT STARTS_WITH(
      IFNULL(d.failed_reason_id, ''),
      'Trash:'
    )

    AND d.deal_status = 'won'

    AND d.closed_at >= DATETIME(
      DATE_SUB(p.report_date, INTERVAL 13 DAY)
    )

    AND d.closed_at < p.day_end

  GROUP BY
    cm.course_key
),

/* =========================================================
   3. Chỉ cần biết deal có từng có activity hay chưa.
   Không cần COUNT(*) activity.
   ========================================================= */
deals_with_activity AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    deal_id

  FROM `tmdatabase.dm_base_crm.deal_activities`
),

/* =========================================================
   4. OPEN METRICS
   Gộp pending + stale open trong cùng một scan.
   ========================================================= */
open_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    cm.course_key,

    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(
      a.deal_id IS NULL
      AND DATE(d.created_at) <= DATE_SUB(
        p.report_date,
        INTERVAL p.warning_pending_days DAY
      ),
      d.deal_id,
      NULL
    )) AS pending_leads,

    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(
      d.stage_start_at IS NOT NULL
      AND DATETIME_DIFF(
        CURRENT_DATETIME('Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'),
        d.stage_start_at,
        DAY
      ) > p.warning_open_deal_days,
      d.deal_id,
      NULL
    )) AS stale_open_deals

  FROM `tmdatabase.dm_base_crm.deals` d

  CROSS JOIN params p

  INNER JOIN course_map cm
    ON cm.raw_key = LOWER(
      TRIM(
        REGEXP_REPLACE(
          IFNULL(d.selected_course, ''),
          r'\s+',
          ' '
        )
      )
    )

  LEFT JOIN deals_with_activity a
    ON a.deal_id = d.deal_id

  WHERE NOT STARTS_WITH(
      IFNULL(d.failed_reason_id, ''),
      'Trash:'
    )

    AND d.deal_status = 'open'

  GROUP BY
    cm.course_key
),

metrics AS (
  SELECT
    c.course_type,
    c.course_name,
    c.course_key,

    IFNULL(lm.lead_now, 0)
      AS lead_now,

    IFNULL(lm.lead_prev, 0)
      AS lead_prev,

    DATE(lm.last_lead_at)
      AS last_lead_date,

    DATE_DIFF(
      p.report_date,
      IFNULL(
        DATE(lm.last_lead_at),
        DATE_SUB(
          p.report_date,
          INTERVAL 999 DAY
        )
      ),
      DAY
    ) AS days_no_lead,

    IFNULL(wm.deal_now, 0)
      AS deal_now,

    IFNULL(wm.deal_prev, 0)
      AS deal_prev,

    IFNULL(om.pending_leads, 0)
      AS pending_leads,

    IFNULL(om.stale_open_deals, 0)
      AS stale_open_deals,

    p.min_base_volume,
    p.warning_drop_pct,
    p.warning_zero_lead_days,
    p.warning_pending_min_count,
    p.warning_open_deal_min

  FROM active_courses c

  CROSS JOIN params p

  LEFT JOIN lead_metrics lm
    ON lm.course_key = c.course_key

  LEFT JOIN won_metrics wm
    ON wm.course_key = c.course_key

  LEFT JOIN open_metrics om
    ON om.course_key = c.course_key
)

SELECT
  course_type,
  course_name,

  ROUND(
    lead_now / 7.0,
    2
  ) AS lead_per_day_now,

  ROUND(
    lead_prev / 7.0,
    2
  ) AS lead_per_day_prev,

  ROUND(
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      lead_now - lead_prev,
      NULLIF(lead_prev, 0)
    ) * 100,
    1
  ) AS lead_delta_pct,

  ROUND(
    deal_now / 7.0,
    2
  ) AS deal_per_day_now,

  ROUND(
    deal_prev / 7.0,
    2
  ) AS deal_per_day_prev,

  ROUND(
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      deal_now - deal_prev,
      NULLIF(deal_prev, 0)
    ) * 100,
    1
  ) AS deal_delta_pct,

  last_lead_date,
  days_no_lead,

  pending_leads,
  stale_open_deals,

  (
    lead_prev >= min_base_volume
    AND SAFE_DIVIDE(
      lead_now - lead_prev,
      lead_prev
    ) * 100 <= -warning_drop_pct
  ) AS flag_lead_drop,

  (
    deal_prev >= min_base_volume
    AND SAFE_DIVIDE(
      deal_now - deal_prev,
      deal_prev
    ) * 100 <= -warning_drop_pct
  ) AS flag_deal_drop,

  (
    days_no_lead >= warning_zero_lead_days
  ) AS flag_no_lead,

  (
    pending_leads >= warning_pending_min_count
  ) AS flag_pending,

  (
    stale_open_deals >= warning_open_deal_min
  ) AS flag_stale_open

FROM metrics

ORDER BY
  flag_lead_drop DESC,
  flag_deal_drop DESC,
  flag_no_lead DESC,
  flag_pending DESC,
  flag_stale_open DESC,
  lead_delta_pct ASC NULLS LAST,
  course_type,
  course_name;

nodes.name: Q5 Warning Scan
nodes.notes: MVP: JOIN dim_course inline. Build Payload loc chi giu dong co >=1 co TRUE.

parameters.sqlQuery:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT
    DATE('{{ $('Resolve Day').first().json.report_date }}')
      AS report_date,

    DATETIME(
      DATE_SUB(
        DATE('{{ $('Resolve Day').first().json.report_date }}'),
        INTERVAL 13 DAY
      )
    ) AS prev_start_dt,

    DATETIME(
      DATE_SUB(
        DATE('{{ $('Resolve Day').first().json.report_date }}'),
        INTERVAL 6 DAY
      )
    ) AS curr_start_dt,

    DATETIME(
      DATE_ADD(
        DATE('{{ $('Resolve Day').first().json.report_date }}'),
        INTERVAL 1 DAY
      )
    ) AS curr_end_exclusive_dt,

    DATETIME(
      DATE('{{ $('Resolve Day').first().json.report_date }}')
    ) AS yesterday_start_dt
),

lead_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(
      d.created_at >= p.yesterday_start_dt
      AND d.created_at < p.curr_end_exclusive_dt,
      d.deal_id,
      NULL
    )) AS leads_yesterday,

    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(
      d.created_at >= p.curr_start_dt,
      d.deal_id,
      NULL
    )) AS curr_leads,

    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(
      d.created_at < p.curr_start_dt,
      d.deal_id,
      NULL
    )) AS prev_leads,

    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(
      d.created_at >= p.curr_start_dt
      AND d.stage_id IN (
        224,264,267,268,265,92,91,227,228,225,229,226,
        220,221,217,222,218,219,75,76,73,74,79,80,
        1328,1329,1330,1331,1332
      ),
      d.deal_id,
      NULL
    )) AS curr_mql,

    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(
      d.created_at < p.curr_start_dt
      AND d.stage_id IN (
        224,264,267,268,265,92,91,227,228,225,229,226,
        220,221,217,222,218,219,75,76,73,74,79,80,
        1328,1329,1330,1331,1332
      ),
      d.deal_id,
      NULL
    )) AS prev_mql,

    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(
      d.created_at >= p.curr_start_dt
      AND d.stage_id IN (
        224,267,268,92,91,227,228,225,229,226,
        220,221,222,218,219,75,76,74,80,
        1329,1330,1331,1332
      ),
      d.deal_id,
      NULL
    )) AS curr_sql_discovery,

    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(
      d.created_at < p.curr_start_dt
      AND d.stage_id IN (
        224,267,268,92,91,227,228,225,229,226,
        220,221,222,218,219,75,76,74,80,
        1329,1330,1331,1332
      ),
      d.deal_id,
      NULL
    )) AS prev_sql_discovery,

    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(
      d.created_at >= p.curr_start_dt
      AND d.stage_id IN (
        224,267,268,92,91,227,228,225,229,226,
        220,221,222,219,75,76,
        1330,1331,1332
      ),
      d.deal_id,
      NULL
    )) AS curr_sql_needfit,

    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(
      d.created_at < p.curr_start_dt
      AND d.stage_id IN (
        224,267,268,92,91,227,228,225,229,226,
        220,221,222,219,75,76,
        1330,1331,1332
      ),
      d.deal_id,
      NULL
    )) AS prev_sql_needfit

  FROM `tmdatabase.dm_base_crm.deals` d
  CROSS JOIN p

  WHERE NOT STARTS_WITH(
      IFNULL(d.failed_reason_id, ''),
      'Trash:'
    )
    AND d.created_at >= p.prev_start_dt
    AND d.created_at < p.curr_end_exclusive_dt
),

outcome_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(
      d.deal_status = 'won'
      AND d.closed_at >= p.yesterday_start_dt,
      d.deal_id,
      NULL
    )) AS won_yesterday,

    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(
      d.closed_at >= p.curr_start_dt
      AND d.deal_status = 'won',
      d.deal_id,
      NULL
    )) AS curr_won,

    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(
      d.closed_at < p.curr_start_dt
      AND d.deal_status = 'won',
      d.deal_id,
      NULL
    )) AS prev_won,

    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(
      d.closed_at >= p.curr_start_dt
      AND d.deal_status = 'lost',
      d.deal_id,
      NULL
    )) AS curr_lost,

    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(
      d.closed_at < p.curr_start_dt
      AND d.deal_status = 'lost',
      d.deal_id,
      NULL
    )) AS prev_lost

  FROM `tmdatabase.dm_base_crm.deals` d
  CROSS JOIN p

  WHERE NOT STARTS_WITH(
      IFNULL(d.failed_reason_id, ''),
      'Trash:'
    )
    AND d.deal_status IN ('won', 'lost')
    AND d.closed_at >= p.prev_start_dt
    AND d.closed_at < p.curr_end_exclusive_dt
),

metrics AS (
  SELECT
    p.report_date,

    l.leads_yesterday,
    o.won_yesterday,

    l.curr_leads / 7.0 AS leads_avg7_curr_raw,
    l.prev_leads / 7.0 AS leads_avg7_prev_raw,

    l.curr_mql / 7.0 AS mql_avg7_curr_raw,
    l.prev_mql / 7.0 AS mql_avg7_prev_raw,

    l.curr_sql_discovery / 7.0 AS sql_discovery_avg7_curr_raw,
    l.prev_sql_discovery / 7.0 AS sql_discovery_avg7_prev_raw,

    l.curr_sql_needfit / 7.0 AS sql_needfit_avg7_curr_raw,
    l.prev_sql_needfit / 7.0 AS sql_needfit_avg7_prev_raw,

    o.curr_won / 7.0 AS won_avg7_curr_raw,
    o.prev_won / 7.0 AS won_avg7_prev_raw,

    o.curr_lost / 7.0 AS lost_avg7_curr_raw,
    o.prev_lost / 7.0 AS lost_avg7_prev_raw,

    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      o.curr_won,
      o.curr_won + o.curr_lost
    ) AS conversion_rate_curr_raw,

    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      o.prev_won,
      o.prev_won + o.prev_lost
    ) AS conversion_rate_prev_raw

  FROM p
  CROSS JOIN lead_metrics l
  CROSS JOIN outcome_metrics o
)

SELECT
  report_date,

  leads_yesterday,
  won_yesterday,

  ROUND(leads_avg7_curr_raw, 2)
    AS leads_avg7_curr,

  ROUND(leads_avg7_prev_raw, 2)
    AS leads_avg7_prev,

  ROUND(
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      leads_avg7_curr_raw - leads_avg7_prev_raw,
      NULLIF(leads_avg7_prev_raw, 0)
    ) * 100,
    1
  ) AS leads_pct_change,

  ROUND(won_avg7_curr_raw, 2)
    AS won_avg7_curr,

  ROUND(won_avg7_prev_raw, 2)
    AS won_avg7_prev,

  ROUND(
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      won_avg7_curr_raw - won_avg7_prev_raw,
      NULLIF(won_avg7_prev_raw, 0)
    ) * 100,
    1
  ) AS won_pct_change,

  ROUND(mql_avg7_curr_raw, 2)
    AS mql_avg7_curr,

  ROUND(mql_avg7_prev_raw, 2)
    AS mql_avg7_prev,

  ROUND(
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      mql_avg7_curr_raw - mql_avg7_prev_raw,
      NULLIF(mql_avg7_prev_raw, 0)
    ) * 100,
    1
  ) AS mql_pct_change,

  ROUND(sql_discovery_avg7_curr_raw, 2)
    AS sql_discovery_avg7_curr,

  ROUND(sql_discovery_avg7_prev_raw, 2)
    AS sql_discovery_avg7_prev,

  ROUND(
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      sql_discovery_avg7_curr_raw - sql_discovery_avg7_prev_raw,
      NULLIF(sql_discovery_avg7_prev_raw, 0)
    ) * 100,
    1
  ) AS sql_discovery_pct_change,

  ROUND(sql_needfit_avg7_curr_raw, 2)
    AS sql_needfit_avg7_curr,

  ROUND(sql_needfit_avg7_prev_raw, 2)
    AS sql_needfit_avg7_prev,

  ROUND(
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      sql_needfit_avg7_curr_raw - sql_needfit_avg7_prev_raw,
      NULLIF(sql_needfit_avg7_prev_raw, 0)
    ) * 100,
    1
  ) AS sql_needfit_pct_change,

  ROUND(lost_avg7_curr_raw, 2)
    AS lost_avg7_curr,

  ROUND(lost_avg7_prev_raw, 2)
    AS lost_avg7_prev,

  ROUND(
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      lost_avg7_curr_raw - lost_avg7_prev_raw,
      NULLIF(lost_avg7_prev_raw, 0)
    ) * 100,
    1
  ) AS lost_pct_change,

  ROUND(
    conversion_rate_curr_raw * 100,
    1
  ) AS conversion_rate_curr,

  ROUND(
    conversion_rate_prev_raw * 100,
    1
  ) AS conversion_rate_prev,

  ROUND(
    (
      conversion_rate_curr_raw
      - conversion_rate_prev_raw
    ) * 100,
    1
  ) AS cvr_change_pp

FROM metrics;

parameters.sqlQuery:
WITH course_map AS (
  SELECT LOWER(TRIM(course_key)) AS raw_key, course_key, course_name, course_type, report_day, is_active
  FROM `tmdatabase.dm_daily_brief.dim_course`
  WHERE course_key IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(course_key) != ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT LOWER(TRIM(a)), course_key, course_name, course_type, report_day, is_active
  FROM `tmdatabase.dm_daily_brief.dim_course`, UNNEST(SPLIT(IFNULL(aliases, ''), ',')) AS a
  WHERE TRIM(a) != '' AND course_key IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(course_key) != ''
), base AS (
  SELECT d.*, LOWER(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(IFNULL(d.selected_course, ''), r'\s+', ' '))) AS raw_key
  FROM `tmdatabase.dm_base_crm.deals` d
  WHERE NOT STARTS_WITH(IFNULL(d.failed_reason_id, ''), 'Trash:')
), vde AS (
  SELECT b.* EXCEPT(raw_key),
    IFNULL(m.course_key, CONCAT('[unmapped] ', b.raw_key)) AS course_key_norm,
    IFNULL(m.course_name, IF(b.raw_key = '', '[CHUA CHON KHOA]', CONCAT('[CHUA MAP] ', b.selected_course))) AS course_name_norm,
    IFNULL(m.course_type, 'Chua phan loai') AS course_type_norm,
    m.report_day, IFNULL(m.is_active, FALSE) AS is_active_course, (m.course_key IS NULL) AS is_unmapped
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN course_map m ON m.raw_key = b.raw_key AND b.raw_key != ''
),
p AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE('Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'), INTERVAL 5 DAY) AS curr_start,
    DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE('Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS curr_end,
    DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE('Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'), INTERVAL 12 DAY) AS prev_start,
    DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE('Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'), INTERVAL 8 DAY) AS prev_end
), lead_agg AS (
  SELECT course_key_norm,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE(created_at) BETWEEN p.curr_start AND p.curr_end, deal_id, NULL)) AS leads_this_week,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE(created_at) BETWEEN p.prev_start AND p.prev_end, deal_id, NULL)) AS leads_last_week
  FROM vde, p
  WHERE DATE(created_at) BETWEEN p.prev_start AND p.curr_end
  GROUP BY course_key_norm
), close_agg AS (
  SELECT course_key_norm,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE(closed_at) BETWEEN p.curr_start AND p.curr_end AND deal_status='won', deal_id, NULL)) AS won_this_week,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE(closed_at) BETWEEN p.curr_start AND p.curr_end AND deal_status='lost', deal_id, NULL)) AS lost_this_week,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE(closed_at) BETWEEN p.prev_start AND p.prev_end AND deal_status='won', deal_id, NULL)) AS won_last_week,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE(closed_at) BETWEEN p.prev_start AND p.prev_end AND deal_status='lost', deal_id, NULL)) AS lost_last_week
  FROM vde, p
  WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL AND DATE(closed_at) BETWEEN p.prev_start AND p.curr_end
  GROUP BY course_key_norm
)
SELECT c.course_type, c.course_name,
  IFNULL(l.leads_this_week,0) AS leads_this_week,
  IFNULL(l.leads_last_week,0) AS leads_last_week,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(IFNULL(l.leads_this_week,0)-IFNULL(l.leads_last_week,0), NULLIF(l.leads_last_week,0))*100 AS lead_delta_pct,
  IFNULL(d.won_this_week,0) AS won_this_week,
  IFNULL(d.lost_this_week,0) AS lost_this_week,
  IFNULL(d.won_last_week,0) AS won_last_week,
  IFNULL(d.lost_last_week,0) AS lost_last_week,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(d.won_this_week, d.won_this_week+d.lost_this_week) AS conversion_rate_this_week,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(d.won_last_week, d.won_last_week+d.lost_last_week) AS conversion_rate_last_week,
  (SAFE_DIVIDE(d.won_this_week,d.won_this_week+d.lost_this_week)-SAFE_DIVIDE(d.won_last_week,d.won_last_week+d.lost_last_week))*100 AS cvr_change_pp
FROM `tmdatabase.dm_daily_brief.dim_course` c
LEFT JOIN lead_agg l ON l.course_key_norm=c.course_key
LEFT JOIN close_agg d ON d.course_key_norm=c.course_key
WHERE c.is_active
ORDER BY won_this_week DESC, conversion_rate_this_week DESC, leads_this_week DESC

parameters.sqlQuery:
WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    DATE('{{ $('Resolve Day').first().json.report_date }}')
      AS report_date,

    -- Current 7 ngày
    DATETIME(
      DATE_SUB(
        DATE('{{ $('Resolve Day').first().json.report_date }}'),
        INTERVAL 6 DAY
      )
    ) AS curr_start_dt,

    -- Prev 7
    DATETIME(
      DATE_SUB(
        DATE('{{ $('Resolve Day').first().json.report_date }}'),
        INTERVAL 13 DAY
      )
    ) AS prev7_start_dt,

    -- Prev 30
    DATETIME(
      DATE_SUB(
        DATE('{{ $('Resolve Day').first().json.report_date }}'),
        INTERVAL 36 DAY
      )
    ) AS prev30_start_dt,

    -- Prev 90
    DATETIME(
      DATE_SUB(
        DATE('{{ $('Resolve Day').first().json.report_date }}'),
        INTERVAL 96 DAY
      )
    ) AS prev90_start_dt,

    -- Kết thúc baseline = đầu current window
    DATETIME(
      DATE_SUB(
        DATE('{{ $('Resolve Day').first().json.report_date }}'),
        INTERVAL 6 DAY
      )
    ) AS baseline_end_dt,

    -- hết report_date
    DATETIME(
      DATE_ADD(
        DATE('{{ $('Resolve Day').first().json.report_date }}'),
        INTERVAL 1 DAY
      )
    ) AS report_end_dt
),

scope AS (
  SELECT
    course_key,
    course_name,
    course_type,
    aliases

  FROM `tmdatabase.dm_daily_brief.dim_course`

  WHERE report_day = {{ $('Resolve Day').first().json.report_day }}
    AND is_active = TRUE
    AND course_key IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(course_key) != ''
),

course_map AS (
  -- course_key chính
  SELECT DISTINCT
    LOWER(
      TRIM(
        REGEXP_REPLACE(
          course_key,
          r'\s+',
          ' '
        )
      )
    ) AS raw_key,

    course_key

  FROM scope

  UNION DISTINCT

  -- aliases
  SELECT DISTINCT
    LOWER(
      TRIM(
        REGEXP_REPLACE(
          alias,
          r'\s+',
          ' '
        )
      )
    ) AS raw_key,

    course_key

  FROM scope,
  UNNEST(
    SPLIT(
      IFNULL(aliases, ''),
      ','
    )
  ) AS alias

  WHERE TRIM(alias) != ''
),

events AS (
  /* ======================================================
     LEAD EVENTS
     Theo created_at
     ====================================================== */
  SELECT
    d.deal_id,

    LOWER(
      TRIM(
        REGEXP_REPLACE(
          IFNULL(d.selected_course, ''),
          r'\s+',
          ' '
        )
      )
    ) AS raw_key,

    d.created_at AS event_at,

    'lead' AS event_type

  FROM `tmdatabase.dm_base_crm.deals` d

  CROSS JOIN params p

  WHERE NOT STARTS_WITH(
      IFNULL(d.failed_reason_id, ''),
      'Trash:'
    )

    AND d.created_at >= p.prev90_start_dt
    AND d.created_at < p.report_end_dt

  UNION ALL

  /* ======================================================
     WON EVENTS
     Theo closed_at
     ====================================================== */
  SELECT
    d.deal_id,

    LOWER(
      TRIM(
        REGEXP_REPLACE(
          IFNULL(d.selected_course, ''),
          r'\s+',
          ' '
        )
      )
    ) AS raw_key,

    d.closed_at AS event_at,

    'won' AS event_type

  FROM `tmdatabase.dm_base_crm.deals` d

  CROSS JOIN params p

  WHERE NOT STARTS_WITH(
      IFNULL(d.failed_reason_id, ''),
      'Trash:'
    )

    AND d.deal_status = 'won'
    AND d.closed_at IS NOT NULL

    AND d.closed_at >= p.prev90_start_dt
    AND d.closed_at < p.report_end_dt
),

mapped_events AS (
  SELECT
    cm.course_key,
    e.deal_id,
    e.event_type,
    e.event_at

  FROM events e

  INNER JOIN course_map cm
    ON cm.raw_key = e.raw_key

  WHERE e.raw_key != ''
),

agg AS (
  SELECT
    e.course_key,

    /* ================= LEADS ================= */

    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(
      e.event_type = 'lead'
      AND e.event_at >= p.curr_start_dt
      AND e.event_at < p.report_end_dt,
      e.deal_id,
      NULL
    )) AS lead_now,

    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(
      e.event_type = 'lead'
      AND e.event_at >= p.prev7_start_dt
      AND e.event_at < p.baseline_end_dt,
      e.deal_id,
      NULL
    )) AS lead_prev7,

    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(
      e.event_type = 'lead'
      AND e.event_at >= p.prev30_start_dt
      AND e.event_at < p.baseline_end_dt,
      e.deal_id,
      NULL
    )) AS lead_prev30,

    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(
      e.event_type = 'lead'
      AND e.event_at >= p.prev90_start_dt
      AND e.event_at < p.baseline_end_dt,
      e.deal_id,
      NULL
    )) AS lead_prev90,

    /* ================= WON ================= */

    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(
      e.event_type = 'won'
      AND e.event_at >= p.curr_start_dt
      AND e.event_at < p.report_end_dt,
      e.deal_id,
      NULL
    )) AS deal_now,

    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(
      e.event_type = 'won'
      AND e.event_at >= p.prev7_start_dt
      AND e.event_at < p.baseline_end_dt,
      e.deal_id,
      NULL
    )) AS deal_prev7,

    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(
      e.event_type = 'won'
      AND e.event_at >= p.prev30_start_dt
      AND e.event_at < p.baseline_end_dt,
      e.deal_id,
      NULL
    )) AS deal_prev30,

    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(
      e.event_type = 'won'
      AND e.event_at >= p.prev90_start_dt
      AND e.event_at < p.baseline_end_dt,
      e.deal_id,
      NULL
    )) AS deal_prev90

  FROM mapped_events e

  CROSS JOIN params p

  GROUP BY
    e.course_key
)

SELECT
  s.course_type,
  s.course_name,

  ROUND(
    IFNULL(a.lead_now, 0) / 7.0,
    2
  ) AS lead_pd_now,

  ROUND(
    IFNULL(a.lead_prev7, 0) / 7.0,
    2
  ) AS lead_pd_prev7,

  ROUND(
    IFNULL(a.lead_prev30, 0) / 30.0,
    2
  ) AS lead_pd_prev30,

  ROUND(
    IFNULL(a.lead_prev90, 0) / 90.0,
    2
  ) AS lead_pd_prev90,

  ROUND(
    IFNULL(a.deal_now, 0) / 7.0,
    2
  ) AS deal_pd_now,

  ROUND(
    IFNULL(a.deal_prev7, 0) / 7.0,
    2
  ) AS deal_pd_prev7,

  ROUND(
    IFNULL(a.deal_prev30, 0) / 30.0,
    2
  ) AS deal_pd_prev30,

  ROUND(
    IFNULL(a.deal_prev90, 0) / 90.0,
    2
  ) AS deal_pd_prev90

FROM scope s

LEFT JOIN agg a
  ON a.course_key = s.course_key

ORDER BY
  deal_pd_now DESC,
  lead_pd_now DESC,
  s.course_name;

parameters.sqlQuery:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT
    DATE('{{ $('Resolve Day').first().json.report_date }}') AS d
),

course_map AS (
  SELECT
    LOWER(
      TRIM(
        REGEXP_REPLACE(
          course_key,
          r'\s+',
          ' '
        )
      )
    ) AS raw_key
  FROM `tmdatabase.dm_daily_brief.dim_course`
  WHERE course_key IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(course_key) != ''

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    LOWER(
      TRIM(
        REGEXP_REPLACE(
          alias,
          r'\s+',
          ' '
        )
      )
    ) AS raw_key
  FROM `tmdatabase.dm_daily_brief.dim_course`,
  UNNEST(SPLIT(IFNULL(aliases, ''), ',')) AS alias
  WHERE TRIM(alias) != ''
    AND course_key IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(course_key) != ''
),

src AS (
  SELECT
    d.deal_id,
    d.selected_course,

    LOWER(
      TRIM(
        REGEXP_REPLACE(
          IFNULL(d.selected_course, ''),
          r'\s+',
          ' '
        )
      )
    ) AS raw_key

  FROM `tmdatabase.dm_base_crm.deals` d
  CROSS JOIN p

  WHERE NOT STARTS_WITH(
      IFNULL(d.failed_reason_id, ''),
      'Trash:'
    )
    AND d.created_at >= DATETIME(p.d)
    AND d.created_at < DATETIME(
      DATE_ADD(p.d, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
    )
),

issues AS (
  SELECT
    s.deal_id,
    s.selected_course,

    CASE
      WHEN s.raw_key = ''
        THEN 'CHUA_CHON_KHOA'
      ELSE 'CHUA_MAP'
    END AS mapping_status

  FROM src s

  LEFT JOIN course_map m
    ON m.raw_key = s.raw_key
   AND s.raw_key != ''

  WHERE s.raw_key = ''
     OR m.raw_key IS NULL
),

summary AS (
  SELECT
    mapping_status,

    CASE
      WHEN mapping_status = 'CHUA_CHON_KHOA'
        THEN 'selected_course rong hoac NULL'
      ELSE
        'selected_course co gia tri nhung khong tim thay trong dim_course'
    END AS issue,

    CASE
      WHEN mapping_status = 'CHUA_CHON_KHOA'
        THEN NULL
      ELSE selected_course
    END AS selected_course_raw,

    CASE
      WHEN mapping_status = 'CHUA_CHON_KHOA'
        THEN '[CHUA CHON KHOA]'
      ELSE CONCAT('[CHUA MAP] ', selected_course)
    END AS course_name,

    COUNT(DISTINCT deal_id) AS deal_count

  FROM issues

  GROUP BY
    mapping_status,
    issue,
    selected_course_raw,
    course_name
)

SELECT
  mapping_status,
  issue,
  selected_course_raw,
  course_name,
  deal_count
FROM summary

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'OK' AS mapping_status,
  'Khong phat hien loi mapping khoa hoc hom qua' AS issue,
  CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS selected_course_raw,
  CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS course_name,
  0 AS deal_count
FROM UNNEST([1]) AS dummy
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM summary
)

ORDER BY
  mapping_status,
  deal_count DESC;

options.systemMessage:
Bạn là BigQuery SQL Writer. Nhiệm vụ duy nhất: viết 1 query read-only để kiểm chứng hypothesis.

Allowlist: tmdatabase.dm_base_crm.deals, stages, pipelines, deal_activities và tmdatabase.dm_daily_brief.dim_course.

Query bắt đầu bằng SELECT hoặc WITH. Loại deal có failed_reason_id bắt đầu bằng Trash:. Nếu dùng deal_activities, aggregate theo deal_id trước khi JOIN. Cửa sổ thời gian tối đa 90 ngày. Không SELECT *. LIMIT tối đa 100. Không chép lại context hoặc hypothesis.

Chỉ trả JSON thuần:
{"sql":"WITH ... SELECT ... LIMIT 100","expected_signal":"Kết quả nào sẽ ủng hộ hoặc bác bỏ hypothesis"}
